text.tspan: Legislative procedure – Industrial Accelerator Act – COM(2026) 100 (proposal)

Procedure 2026/0068(COD). State as of 12 Nov 2026: steps done and in progress are marked. Upper part: the ordinary legislative procedure (Art. 294 TFEU); lower part: the act's procedure over time. Every event cites its source (see industrial-accelerator-act.html).
Working party; no Council mandate in the register
Act adopted in the wording of the EP
approves or no decision → adopted (7a); rejects
both adopt → adopted; otherwise not adopted
Informal: trilogues of EP, Council and Commission at every stage (Joint Declaration 2007, points 7–9); a trilogue agreement confirmed by Coreper and
offered by letter to the EP committee chair (point 14) leads to adoption at first reading, or, after the EP first reading, to an early second reading.
29 Apr 2026 · IMCO rapporteur appointed (Pierre Jouvet, S-D)
29 Apr 2026 · INTA rapporteur appointed (Anna Cavazzini, VERTS-ALE)
29 Apr 2026 · ITRE rapporteur appointed (Christophe Grudler, RENEW)
30 Apr 2026 · Referral to committee announced in plenary
